issues.description: Method getTotalNumberOfStudents(): The problem statement UML declares the method as public (shown as '+getTotalNumberOfStudents(): int' in problem_statement.md line 70), but the reference solution implements it with protected visibility ('protected int getTotalNumberOfStudents()' in solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java line 75). This visibility mismatch can confuse students about the intended API and may cause tests or grading code that expect a public method to fail or disagree with the reference implementation.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the visibility consistent. Preferred fix: change the reference implementation signature to public by replacing 'protected int getTotalNumberOfStudents()' with 'public int getTotalNumberOfStudents()' so it matches the UML and instructions. Alternatively, if protected visibility was intended for pedagogical reasons, update the problem statement UML and textual description to show protected visibility and explain why.
